name: m7a-reminders
title: Local reminders and re-enable prompt
issue: Port Android core/domain/src/main/kotlin/com/qamooscheh/core/domain/reminders/ReminderSchedule.kt to Packages/QDomain with XCTest (pure schedule maths, time zones, DST). Then a thin scheduler in Packages/QData over a protocol around UNUserNotificationCenter (fake in tests), reference Android core/data/src/main/kotlin/com/qamooscheh/core/data/Reminders.kt and web src/pages/settings/StreakSection.tsx. Include the re-enable prompt state when permission is denied (deep link to Settings). Only binds the m6m protocol in the settings UI. Where web and Android differ, match the Android app's behaviour (see core/domain/src/main/kotlin/com/qamooscheh/core/domain/reminders/ReminderSchedule.kt). No Swift toolchain locally: push early and fix from CI. Keep each slice under ~600 changed lines; if it grows, stop and report a split. Also (issue #14): add cancelAll() to ReminderScheduling (SettingsLogic.swift); AppEnvironment.live's signOut must call it and withdraw delivered reminders; every scheduled or snoozed job is tagged with the scheduling user's id and posts only while that user is signed in, reading only that user's settings.
acceptance: CI green (swift test per package, xcodebuild test)
Schedule maths tests cover DST and travel across time zones
Sign-out cancels scheduled and snoozed reminders and withdraws delivered ones (test with the fake center)
A job posts only when the account that scheduled it is signed in, and never reads another learner's settings (test)
